args.body: Hello, sorry, our system wrongly logged your report as a fridge problem and sent you fridge questions. Please ignore those. We have corrected it to a front door repair and marked it urgent, as a door that needs slamming can damage the glass and may not secure properly. Until it is fixed, please close the doors gently and make sure the front door is locked when you go out or at night. Please keep away from the glass if it cracks. Could you tell us: 1) is the door glass cracked or loose now? 2) does the door lock securely when shut? 3) what times suit for access, any entry codes or alarms, and are there pets? We are asking the landlord to approve the repair; the target for urgent work is within 72 hours once approved. We will update you by 7 June.
